mapper.select: SELECT id, name, sort, created_at, updated_at FROM config_groups ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO config_groups (name, sort, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{sort}, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE system_configs SET group_id = 0, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
